about: Real OOXML array/spill and data-table dependent caches, selected without their anchor. Tests/test_worksheet_r_examples.py writes each workbook and runs the actual loader, grid mutation path, native formatter and R. Both sparse snapshot and ordinary cell-JSON representations are qualified.

schema.extends: The Mac worksheet R fixture schema, with explicit OOXML-only additions below.
schema.formulaAnchors: Anchor address -> {type: array|dataTable, range: Excel reference, optional r1/r2/dt2D}. The cell itself has formula/value. Children contain no f element.
schema.cached: A cell {cached: value} writes a dependent cached result with no formula element. null writes a cell with no cache; {text:""} writes t="str" with an explicit empty v.
schema.edits: Existing cell address -> text typed after the workbook opens, through store.apply and workbook.changed.
schema.loaderMode: snapshot (default) uses the real typed binary snapshot; cells requests ordinary JSON cells from the same engine loader.
